name: Bar & Restaurant
description: Full-service restaurant featuring an integrated, high-volume beverage and bar program where craft cocktails, curated wine, draft beer, and culinary dining operate as co-equal revenue streams. Features support for age-verified beverage ordering, time-scheduled happy hours, multi-course dining, premium grill options, and bar-only versus dining room menu configurations.

sections.name: Cocktails
sections.description: Handcrafted cocktail program featuring house mixology creations, traditional classic standards, and frozen blended specialties. Acts as a core high-margin revenue driver and defines the venue's social, evening, and nightlife identity.

subSections.name: Signature Cocktails
subSections.description: Proprietary house creations developed by our mixologists using small-batch infusions, house-made syrups, and innovative flavor combinations.

subSections.name: Classic Cocktails
subSections.description: Time-honored cocktail standards prepared strictly according to iconic recipes, including Old Fashioneds, Negronis, Martinis, and Margaritas.

subSections.name: Frozen & Blended Cocktails
subSections.description: Chilled blended drinks, frozen margaritas, and slush cocktails ideal for patio seating, warm weather, and high-energy gatherings.

sections.name: Wines
sections.description: Curated wine cellar program offering red, white, rosé, sparkling, and dessert wines available by the glass, carafe, half-bottle, or full bottle. Selected to pair harmoniously with dinner entrées, grilled meats, and seafood.

subSections.name: Red Wines
subSections.description: Light to full-bodied reds including Pinot Noir, Merlot, Malbec, and Cabernet Sauvignon, structured to pair with steaks, burgers, and braised meats.

subSections.name: White Wines
subSections.description: Crisp, aromatic, and oak-aged white varietals including Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Grigio, and Chardonnay, suited for seafood, poultry, and salads.

subSections.name: Rosé
subSections.description: Dry, Provence-style and fruit-forward rosé wines offering lively acidity, red berry notes, and versatile dining pairings.

subSections.name: Sparkling & Champagne
subSections.description: Champagne, Prosecco, Cava, and sparkling wines ideal for celebratory toasts, welcome aperitifs, and sparkling cocktails.

subSections.name: Dessert Wines
subSections.description: Fortified, late-harvest, and botrytized sweet dessert wines such as Tawny Port, Sauternes, and Icewine for digestif pairing.

sections.name: Beers & Ciders
sections.description: Comprehensive beer program featuring rotating draft lines, bottled lagers, craft IPAs, stouts, and artisanal ciders. Caters to casual bar customers, sports viewers, and dining patrons seeking refreshing malt and apple pairings.

subSections.name: Draft Beer
subSections.description: Freshly pulled draft beers from chilled glycol lines, serving crisp lagers, pilsners, IPAs, and dark stouts on tap.

subSections.name: Bottled & Canned Beer
subSections.description: Popular domestic beers, international imported lagers, and specialty canned craft brews kept ice-cold.

subSections.name: Craft & Local Beer
subSections.description: Local microbrewery partnerships, hazy IPAs, fruited sours, and seasonal small-batch releases.

subSections.name: Ciders
subSections.description: Hard fermented apple, pear, and berry ciders providing crisp, refreshing, and naturally gluten-free beverage choices.

sections.name: Spirits & Liquors
sections.description: Extensive back-bar collection of aged whiskeys, vodkas, gins, rums, 100% agave tequilas, and cognacs. Supports premium neat pours, rocks sipping, and custom highball combinations.

subSections.name: Whiskey & Bourbon
subSections.description: Single malts, small-batch bourbons, spicy ryes, and international whiskies from Scotland, Ireland, Japan, and Kentucky.

subSections.name: Vodka
subSections.description: High-purity wheat, rye, and potato distilled vodkas along with citrus and herb botanical infusions.

subSections.name: Gin
subSections.description: London dry, contemporary botanical, Old Tom, and barrel-aged gins featuring juniper, coriander, and citrus peel.

subSections.name: Rum
subSections.description: Aged Caribbean dark rums, spiced rums, agricole cane rums, and smooth white rums.

subSections.name: Tequila & Mezcal
subSections.description: 100% blue Weber agave tequilas (Blanco, Reposado, Añejo) and artisanal pit-roasted smoky mezcals.

subSections.name: Brandy & Cognac
subSections.description: Aged grape brandies, VSOP, and XO Cognacs designed for slow sipping and post-dinner digestif service.

choices.label: On the Rocks (Single Pour over Large Clear Ice Cube)

sections.name: Mocktails & Non-Alcoholic
sections.description: Sophisticated alcohol-free mixology creations, non-alcoholic craft beers, and zero-proof spirits. Ensures designated drivers, mindful drinkers, and non-alcohol consumers enjoy an elevated bar beverage experience.

subSections.name: Mocktails
subSections.description: Artisanal zero-proof cocktails formulated with botanical extracts, freshly pressed juices, house syrups, and herbs.

subSections.name: Non-Alcoholic Beers
subSections.description: 0.0% to 0.5% ABV brewed craft beers delivering authentic hop bitterness, malt profile, and crisp foam head.

subSections.name: Non-Alcoholic Wines & Spirits
subSections.description: Dealcoholized sparkling wines, still varietals, and distilled botanical zero-proof spirit alternatives.

sections.name: Bar Bites & Sharing Plates
sections.description: Fast-casual savory finger foods, loaded nachos, wings, sliders, and communal platters tailored for sharing at the bar, lounge tables, and group gatherings. Drives high food attach rates with drink orders.

subSections.name: Hot Bar Snacks
subSections.description: Warm, crispy, and savory shareables like loaded fries, chicken wings, sliders, mozzarella sticks, and calamari.

subSections.name: Cold Bar Snacks
subSections.description: Chilled savory grazing bites including house-roasted spiced nuts, artisan olives, dips, and vegetable crudités.

subSections.name: Sharing Boards & Platters
subSections.description: Artisan charcuterie boards, cheese flights, towering nacho plates, and tasting boards designed for groups.

sections.name: Appetizers & Starters
sections.description: Refined culinary beginnings for seated restaurant dining. Features house-simmered soups, crisp dressed salads, and plated small bites that prime the appetite for main courses.

subSections.name: Soups
subSections.description: Freshly simmered broths, creamy seasonal chowders, and rich seafood bisques served with warm crusty bread.

subSections.name: Salads
subSections.description: Crisp farm greens, classic Caesar salads, burrata bowls, and grain medleys paired with house-made dressings.

subSections.name: Small Plates
subSections.description: Composed culinary starters including beef carpaccio, tuna tartare, pan-seared sea scallops, and artisan bruschetta.

sections.name: Main Courses / Entrées
sections.description: Substantial dinner and lunch centerpiece dishes spanning poultry, braised meats, seafood, artisanal pasta, and wholesome plant-based culinary creations that anchor table service dining.

subSections.name: Meat & Poultry
subSections.description: Pan-roasted poultry, slow-braised short ribs, duck breast, and tender pork medallions served with savory glazes.

subSections.name: Seafood
subSections.description: Sustainable fresh catches, pan-seared sea bass, roasted salmon, and seafood risottos.

subSections.name: Pasta & Rice
subSections.description: Handcrafted fresh pasta, slow-simmered bolognese, creamy wild mushroom risotto, and paella-inspired grain dishes.

subSections.name: Vegetarian & Vegan Mains
subSections.description: Hearty plant-forward centerpieces like roasted cauliflower steaks, lentil bolognese, and mushroom bourguignon.

sections.name: Grills & Specialties
sections.description: Flame-grilled butcher steaks, slow-smoked barbecue ribs, char-grilled seafood, and chef specialty cuts cooked over high heat according to customer doneness preferences.

subSections.name: Steaks & Cuts
subSections.description: Prime wet and dry-aged beef cuts such as Filet Mignon, Ribeye, New York Strip, and Tomahawk seared over open fire.

subSections.name: Ribs & BBQ
subSections.description: Slow-smoked baby back ribs, brisket, and barbecue glazed cuts served with house bastes.

subSections.name: Grilled Seafood
subSections.description: Whole grilled Mediterranean fish, grilled lobster tails, and jumbo tiger prawns with fresh herbs and citrus butter.

subSections.name: House Specialties
subSections.description: Signature tavern specialties, surf & turf pairings, and chef-curated premium meat platters.

sections.name: Sides
sections.description: A la carte accompaniments, hot potato dishes, seasonal vegetables, fresh side salads, and house-made sauces that allow guests to customize their dining experience.

subSections.name: Hot Sides
subSections.description: Warm accompaniments such as roasted fingerling potatoes, truffle fries, creamed spinach, and baked mac & cheese.

subSections.name: Cold Sides
subSections.description: Chilled accompaniments including tangy coleslaw, cucumber dill salad, and pickled seasonal vegetables.

subSections.name: Sauces
subSections.description: Ramekins of signature gravies, house aiolis, steak sauces, relishes, and flavored butters.

sections.name: Desserts
sections.description: Decadent post-dinner sweet courses including warm baked pastries, artisan gelato, chilled crèmes, and celebration cakes designed to extend table turnover and boost check totals.

subSections.name: Hot Desserts
subSections.description: Oven-fresh warm desserts such as molten chocolate lava cake, warm berry crumbles, and brioche bread pudding.

subSections.name: Cold Desserts
subSections.description: Chilled desserts including espresso tiramisu, vanilla panna cotta, and artisan gelato or fruit sorbets.

subSections.name: Cakes
subSections.description: Rich multi-layer cakes, New York cheesecakes, chocolate tortes, and celebration slices.

sections.name: Kids' Menu
sections.description: Child-friendly meals, drinks, and mini desserts crafted with approachable flavors for guests aged 12 and under. Set to hidden by default for nightlife and cocktail bar concepts, enabling flexible family daytime dining.

subSections.name: Kids' Mains
subSections.description: Approachable mains such as crispy chicken tenders, mini cheeseburger sliders, creamy mac and cheese, and cheese flatbreads.

subSections.name: Kids' Drinks
subSections.description: Child-friendly beverages like pure apple juice, whole milk, chocolate milk, and non-alcoholic kiddie cocktails.

subSections.name: Kids' Desserts
subSections.description: Fun small desserts including mini ice cream sundaes, warm chocolate chip cookies, and fresh fruit bowls.

sections.name: Hot Beverages
sections.description: Barista-crafted espresso drinks, freshly brewed drip coffees, herbal teas, and liqueur-spiked warm beverages for morning brunch, afternoon meetings, or post-meal dining service.

subSections.name: Coffee
subSections.description: Espresso, Americano, Cappuccino, Flat White, Latte, and specialty warm spiked coffees (e.g. Irish Coffee).

subSections.name: Tea
subSections.description: Whole-leaf black, green, herbal, and floral caffeine-free infusions served in individual brewing teapots.

sections.name: Soft Drinks
sections.description: Cold non-alcoholic refreshments spanning freshly squeezed citrus juices, fountain and craft sodas, tonic waters, and bottled premium mineral waters.

subSections.name: Fresh Juices
subSections.description: Cold-pressed and fresh-squeezed orange, ruby red grapefruit, crisp apple, and antioxidant fruit blends.

subSections.name: Soft Drinks
subSections.description: Fountain sodas, artisan craft colas, ginger ale, tonic water, and freshly brewed iced teas.

subSections.name: Water
subSections.description: Imported sparkling mineral water, still natural spring water bottles, and chilled carafes.

sections.name: Happy Hour / Specials
sections.description: Time-restricted promotional drinks, discounted draft beers, house wines, and paired food bundles active during late-afternoon and early-evening hours to attract after-work crowds.

subSections.name: Happy Hour Drinks
subSections.description: Discounted pints of draft beer, select house wines by the glass, well highballs, and promotional featured cocktails.

subSections.name: Happy Hour Food Deals
subSections.description: Specially priced bar bites, slider combos, loaded nachos, and drink-and-snack bundle deals.

timeBehavior.note: Available Monday through Friday between 16:00 and 19:00 in the bar, lounge, and high-top dining sections.

sections.name: Seasonal & Limited
sections.description: Rotating seasonal culinary specials, guest brewery draft takeovers, holiday cocktail features, and chef market finds that keep the menu dynamic and encourage repeat visits.

subSections.name: Seasonal Cocktails
subSections.description: Quarterly mixology creations highlighting seasonal stone fruits, summer spritzes, spiced autumn botanicals, or winter warmers.

subSections.name: Rotating Taps
subSections.description: Limited-quantity guest brewery kegs, fresh wet-hop harvest ales, and rare seasonal beers on rotating draft lines.

subSections.name: Specials
subSections.description: Chef's daily dinner features, fresh seafood market catches, and holiday celebration dishes.

systemFeatures.name: Age Verification
systemFeatures.description: Enforces digital age gate verification for ordering alcohol-containing beverages including cocktails, wine, beer, and spirits.

systemFeatures.name: Happy Hour Pricing & Schedules
systemFeatures.description: Time-based promotional discount engine and automated menu availability during scheduled happy hour periods.

systemFeatures.name: Spice Levels
systemFeatures.description: Customer-selectable heat indicators for chicken wings, savory bar bites, and spicy entrées.

systemFeatures.name: Meat Doneness Selection
systemFeatures.description: Mandatory steak and grilled meat cooking temperatures communicated directly to the kitchen ticket system.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Badges
systemFeatures.description: Visual allergen warnings, dietary badges, and nutritional filter indicators displayed across food and beverage items.

systemFeatures.name: Real-Time Inventory Badges
systemFeatures.description: Live stock indicators highlighting available, low stock, sold out, or rotating draft keg statuses.

systemFeatures.name: Kids' Menu Management
systemFeatures.description: Configurable family dining section that can be hidden or shown depending on venue vibe and evening hours.

systemFeatures.name: Wine Metadata & Tasting Notes
systemFeatures.description: Structured wine attributes including vintage, wine region, country of origin, grape varietal, ABV, and sommelier tasting notes.

systemFeatures.name: Serving Size Options
systemFeatures.description: Multi-tier pour and portion sizes for drinks (glass, carafe, bottle, pint, flight) and food (regular, sharing).
